subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Contender**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "**contender**" means someone who competes for a prize or title. (कोई व्यक्ति जो किसी पुरस्कार या उपाधि के लिए प्रतिस्पर्धा करता हो) • **Example**: *She emerged as a strong contender for the leadership position.* • It is a noun that can be used to describe someone who is in competition with others. • Use "contender" when referring to someone or something involved in a competition or contest. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Compete**: This is a verb which means to take part in a competition. (किसी प्रतियोगिता में भाग लेने के लिए) • **Contend**: This is also a verb which means to struggle or compete, often in a challenging situation. (संघर्ष करना या प्रतिस्पर्धा करना) • **Quickly**: This is an adverb, it describes the rapid or prompt execution of an action. (किसी कार्य का शीघ्र निष्पादन) 48:T71f, The correct answer is: **With**
